scope: Eight finite/local mechanisms; no global source theorem or Lean solution certified.

balancing.control: At k=0 the normalized spherical covariance is I/n even for singular A, so the inward kernel term is zero.

projection_products.smaller_product_control: Two triangles have smaller ratio than the four-simplex.

fresh_noise.control: Reusing the current noise in both branches makes the zero-tolerance tie probability one, above the claimed independent-grid bound.

markov_gluing.control: Three pairwise anti-correlated binary laws have consistent single-vertex marginals but no global joint law on a triangle.

boolean_sampler.collision_control: Three zero shifts yield eight bit labels but only one distinct group element.

periodization.control: Removing the radius buffer creates a periodic seam gap for L=1.1 and centers 0.75+2Z.

weighted_graph_transport.control: The constant output sequence 1 has finite weighted input sum but is not norm-null.

lifted_absorption.inexact_lift_control: The proposed inverse fails after replacing the exact correction by 3/4 of it.
lifted_absorption.scope: The shift model contains linear c0 and does not model the source no-linear-copy obstruction.
